clue.text: Dare bather change into costume that is so worn out?

indicators.note: the bather is told to change, so the letters of these two words are rearranged into something new

explanation.surface: A swimmer is urged to get into a costume, but is it too tatty to wear?
explanation.walkthrough: 'change into' looks like getting dressed; it tells you to rearrange DARE BATHER. 'costume that is so' only frames the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabric worn so thin its threads show is shabby, used up, past its best.

clue.text: No right to have attempted to have drawn

indicators.note: no right means the letter for right is dropped from the other word

parts.note: to have attempted is to have tried

explanation.surface: Someone without a right to try something has ended up level.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawn game ends level, with the scores equal.

clue.text: Joseph and I come in to give an answer

indicators.note: the two named people enter the middle of the other word

parts.note: to render is to give or hand over
Jo is a short form of Joseph

explanation.surface: Joseph and the speaker arrive to give a reply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'come in' looks like an invitation to enter; it is the container signal. Jo is accepted as a short form of Joseph.
explanation.definitionFit: A retort or sharp reply to a remark.

clue.text: Donkey goes round by the canyon

indicators.note: the animal's name surrounds the short word that follows it

parts.note: an ass is a donkey

explanation.surface: A donkey walks a loop beside a gorge.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep chasm or gorge, as a canyon is.

clue.text: Chicken found right in the water heater

indicators.note: the letter for right is placed inside the heater's name

parts.note: a boiler heats water in a house

explanation.surface: A chicken has turned up inside the hot-water tank.
explanation.definitionFit: A young bird reared for roasting or grilling is sold under this name.

clue.text: Square boy?

definitions.meaning: ... Square is a garden square in Bloomsbury, central London
a boy's first name, as in a lad called Russ

explanation.surface: A fellow described as old-fashioned and dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a London square in Bloomsbury and a common given name for a male child.

clue.text: Lifeless dwelling-place

definitions.meaning: lacking sparkle or energy, as a dull performance
an apartment on one floor of a building

explanation.definitionFit: Dull and lacking spirit, and also a set of rooms forming a home on one storey.

clue.text: Girl consumes some pilau ravenously

indicators.note: the following words swallow some letters, so a run hides inside them

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A young woman wolfs down a plate of spiced rice.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'Girl consumes' as the definition, but a name is a noun; 'consumes some' is the hiding indicator, the rice words holding the name.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, so a girl can be called this.

clue.text: One who comes into property without inheriting it

definitions.text: One who comes into property without inheriting it

parts.words: One who comes into property without inheriting it
parts.note: 'comes into property' usually means inheriting land; here it means literally walking onto someone's land unasked

explanation.surface: Someone acquires an estate other than through a will.
explanation.definitionFit: An intruder who enters land without the owner's permission.

clue.text: Examine the pay-desk

definitions.meaning: to check something out is to inspect it
the counter in a shop where customers pay

explanation.definitionFit: A phrasal verb meaning inspect, and the till point in a supermarket.

clue.text: Have the benefit of experience?

definitions.meaning: to possess and profit from
to undergo or have, as in ... a run of success

explanation.surface: Is it wise to profit from what one has lived through?
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to benefit from owning something and to undergo it, often with pleasure.

clue.text: Hops in here to dry

parts.note: reads like someone jumping inside to get out of the rain, but describes a kiln where the hop crop is dried

explanation.surface: Someone leaps indoors to escape getting wet.
explanation.definitionFit: A Kentish kiln building with a cowl where harvested hops are dried for brewing.

clue.text: Unruly Sid loves to break up

indicators.note: unruly suggests disorder, so the letters of the two words are jumbled

explanation.surface: Badly behaved Sid enjoys wrecking things.
explanation.definitionFit: To melt away, or for an assembly or partnership to be dissolved and broken apart.

clue.text: Vice of leader in temporary quarters

indicators.note: the letter is placed inside the word for the encampment

parts.note: a camp is lodging set up for a short time
L, the letter at the head of the word leader

explanation.surface: A fault in the man in charge of a makeshift base.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vice' poses as a moral failing; it is the workshop tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A vice is a tool gripping work between jaws, which a clamp also does.

clue.text: Clergy on board shaken after a meal

indicators.note: in a down answer, one piece sitting on another comes below it, so it follows

parts.note: a table is a board, as in bed and board
the cloth is a collective term for the clergy

explanation.surface: Churchmen aboard a ship are left queasy after dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shaken' hints at seasick clergy; it is the crumbs being shaken off the linen.
explanation.definitionFit: The linen cover laid for dining, which gets shaken out once the diners finish.

clue.text: Accountant who listens?

definitions.meaning: one who checks a firm's accounts
from Latin audire, to hear, so a hearer

explanation.surface: An accountant with a good ear.
explanation.definitionFit: An official inspector of financial records, and literally a hearer.

clue.text: Test out cake in a court of justice

indicators.note: the cake goes inside the word for the test

parts.note: a trial is a test, as in a trial run
a bun is a small cake

explanation.surface: Trying out a cake in a courtroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A body appointed to hear and judge disputes, like a court.

clue.text: She has her pride

parts.note: reads as a woman with self-respect, but a pride is a group of lions

explanation.surface: A woman with self-respect.
explanation.definitionFit: The female big cat living in a group called a pride.

clue.text: Not hard cash presumably

parts.note: hard cash means coins and notes; read as cash that is not difficult to get

explanation.surface: Money that is not in coins and notes.
explanation.definitionFit: Income gained with little effort.

clue.text: Crazy ruling accepting king who is lying in wait

indicators.note: the jumbled word takes in the letter for king
crazy says the letters of the next word go wild

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A mad decree that lets in a monarch who hides in ambush.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crazy' scrambles the word ruling into a word meaning tempting, and 'accepting' has that word take in the king's letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Hiding, waiting unseen to pounce.

clue.text: It hardly moves down the mountain

definitions.text: It hardly moves down the mountain

parts.words: It hardly moves down the mountain
parts.note: describes something creeping downhill, so slowly it barely moves

explanation.surface: Something barely shifts down a slope.
explanation.definitionFit: A slow river of ice that creeps down a valley.

clue.text: Entertainer tries at diversification

indicators.note: making something varied signals that the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A performer tries to branch out.
explanation.definitionFit: A professional performer, such as a singer or dancer.

clue.text: Reach a church before I take the first lady

indicators.note: one piece coming before another means it comes earlier in the answer

parts.note: Eve was the first woman in the Bible

explanation.surface: A churchgoer brings the President's wife along.
explanation.definitionFit: To attain or arrive at a goal.

clue.text: Shy upturned rodent

parts.note: coy means shy
the word up is in the clue turned over, giving its letters backwards

explanation.surface: A bashful animal lies on its back.
explanation.definitionFit: A large South American water rodent, also called nutria.

clue.text: Submit produce

definitions.meaning: to give way or surrender
crops or output, the harvest a field gives

explanation.definitionFit: To give in, and the amount of a crop or return gained.

clue.text: Cyst that hero Martin was disguising

indicators.note: the words conceal the answer within them as a disguise conceals a face

explanation.surface: A heroic man called Martin was hiding a growth.
explanation.definitionFit: A fatty deposit or sebaceous growth, a kind of cyst in older usage.

clue.text: Out Dora and I set

indicators.note: out means wrong or disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Dora and the speaker head off.
explanation.definitionFit: A wireless receiver, a set for listening to broadcasts.

clue.text: Able to go where one likes at no charge

definitions.text: Able to go where one likes
definitions.meaning: at liberty, unrestricted
costing nothing

explanation.surface: Being at liberty costs nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: At liberty, and also costing nothing to obtain.

clue.text: Worker having force

definitions.meaning: a factory hand or machine operator
in effect, as a rule that is in force

explanation.definitionFit: A factory hand, and an adjective for a law or rule currently in effect.

clue.text: He gives Spaniard alternative

parts.note: Don is a Spanish title for a gentleman
or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A Spanish gentleman offers another option.
explanation.definitionFit: A benefactor who contributes money, blood or organs.

clue.text: Nasty side of the park?

definitions.meaning: Mr ..., the evil self of Dr Jekyll in Stevenson's tale
... Park, the large royal park in central London

explanation.definitionFit: Jekyll's wicked alter ego, and a famous London park.

clue.text: Unexceptionally devoted as a printer to his craft?

definitions.meaning: acting just as expected, characteristic

definitions.text: devoted as a printer to his craft?
definitions.meaning: a printer sets type, so a loyal printer is faithful to it

explanation.surface: A printer is wholly committed to his trade.
explanation.definitionFit: Behaving characteristically, and humorously a printer faithful to his letters.
